title: Assistant citation and flag rate
description: The assistant's headline series, computed from the rows the product keeps (feature-specs/21 § 5.3). Every query is a statement of lib/metrics/sql; npm run assistant:metrics prints the same numbers. Generated: change lib/metrics/dashboard.ts and run npm run observe:generate.

panels.title: citation rate
panels.description: citation rate: of the answers that made claims, the share whose citation verdict is PASS with no claim replaced. An answer is an assistant row that is neither a refusal nor a failed turn. One with no claims to check (citation verdict NA: a walk, whose numbers are the script's) is outside the rate. Over the dashboard's range, by month: with the default range, the month to date.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.bucket AS "time", s.value AS "citation rate"
FROM (
-- citation rate: of the answers that made claims, the share whose citation verdict is PASS with no claim replaced.
-- An answer is an assistant row that is neither a refusal nor a failed turn. One with no claims to check
-- (citation verdict NA: a walk, whose numbers are the script's) is outside the rate.
-- Parameters: 1 window start (inclusive), 2 window end (exclusive), 3 the bucket, a unit date_trunc takes. UTC, as stored.
SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, m."createdAt") AS bucket,
       ''::text AS key,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.verdict = 'PASS' AND m.substituted = 0)::float8 AS n,
       count(*)::float8 AS d,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.verdict = 'PASS' AND m.substituted = 0)::float8 / count(*)::float8 AS value
FROM "Message" m
JOIN "SensorVerdict" v ON v."messageId" = m.id AND v.sensor = 'citation'
WHERE m.role = 'ASSISTANT'
  AND m."refusalCause" IS NULL
  AND m."modelId" IS NOT NULL
  AND v.verdict <> 'NA'
  AND m."createdAt" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp
  AND m."createdAt" < $__timeTo()::timestamp
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
) s
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: flag rate
panels.description: flag rate: flagged assistant messages over assistant messages, as 'any' and one line per coded reason. A message is counted in its own bucket, whenever the flag was placed. Over the dashboard's range, by month: with the default range, the month to date.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.bucket AS "time", s.key AS metric, s.value
FROM (
-- flag rate: flagged assistant messages over assistant messages, as 'any' and one line per coded reason.
-- A message is counted in its own bucket, whenever the flag was placed.
-- Parameters: 1 window start (inclusive), 2 window end (exclusive), 3 the bucket, a unit date_trunc takes. UTC, as stored.
WITH turns AS (
  SELECT m.id, date_trunc('month'::text, m."createdAt") AS bucket
  FROM "Message" m
  WHERE m.role = 'ASSISTANT'
    AND m."createdAt" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp
    AND m."createdAt" < $__timeTo()::timestamp
), totals AS (
  SELECT bucket, count(*)::float8 AS d FROM turns GROUP BY 1
), flagged AS (
  SELECT t.bucket, t.id, f.reason
  FROM turns t
  JOIN "Flag" f ON f."messageId" = t.id
)
SELECT tot.bucket,
       'any'::text AS key,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT x.id) FROM flagged x WHERE x.bucket = tot.bucket)::float8 AS n,
       tot.d,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT x.id) FROM flagged x WHERE x.bucket = tot.bucket)::float8 / tot.d AS value
FROM totals tot
UNION ALL
SELECT tot.bucket,
       x.reason AS key,
       count(DISTINCT x.id)::float8 AS n,
       tot.d,
       count(DISTINCT x.id)::float8 / tot.d AS value
FROM flagged x
JOIN totals tot ON tot.bucket = x.bucket
GROUP BY tot.bucket, x.reason, tot.d
ORDER BY 1, 2
) s
WHERE s.key = 'any'
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: refusal rate
panels.description: refusal rate by cause: refusals over turns, as 'any' and one line per cause. A turn is an assistant row: an answer, a refusal or a failed turn. Over the dashboard's range, by month: with the default range, the month to date.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.bucket AS "time", s.key AS metric, s.value
FROM (
-- refusal rate by cause: refusals over turns, as 'any' and one line per cause.
-- A turn is an assistant row: an answer, a refusal or a failed turn.
-- Parameters: 1 window start (inclusive), 2 window end (exclusive), 3 the bucket, a unit date_trunc takes. UTC, as stored.
WITH turns AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, m."createdAt") AS bucket, m."refusalCause" AS cause
  FROM "Message" m
  WHERE m.role = 'ASSISTANT'
    AND m."createdAt" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp
    AND m."createdAt" < $__timeTo()::timestamp
), totals AS (
  SELECT bucket, count(*)::float8 AS d, count(cause)::float8 AS refused FROM turns GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT tot.bucket, 'any'::text AS key, tot.refused AS n, tot.d, tot.refused / tot.d AS value
FROM totals tot
UNION ALL
SELECT tot.bucket, t.cause AS key, count(*)::float8 AS n, tot.d, count(*)::float8 / tot.d AS value
FROM turns t
JOIN totals tot ON tot.bucket = t.bucket
WHERE t.cause IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY tot.bucket, t.cause, tot.d
ORDER BY 1, 2
) s
WHERE s.key = 'any'
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: first-token p95
panels.description: first-token p95: the 95th percentile of the time to the first token, in milliseconds, over the turns that streamed one. Over the dashboard's range, by month: with the default range, the month to date.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.bucket AS "time", s.value AS "first-token p95"
FROM (
-- first-token p95: the 95th percentile of the time to the first token, in milliseconds, over the turns that streamed one.
-- Parameters: 1 window start (inclusive), 2 window end (exclusive), 3 the bucket, a unit date_trunc takes. UTC, as stored.
SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, m."createdAt") AS bucket,
       ''::text AS key,
       NULL::float8 AS n,
       count(*)::float8 AS d,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m."firstTokenMs") AS value
FROM "Message" m
WHERE m.role = 'ASSISTANT'
  AND m."firstTokenMs" IS NOT NULL
  AND m."createdAt" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp
  AND m."createdAt" < $__timeTo()::timestamp
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
) s
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: grounded distribution
panels.description: grounded distribution: the median (p50) and the 10th percentile (p10) of the grader's score, over the graded answers.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.bucket AS "time", s.key AS metric, s.value
FROM (
-- grounded distribution: the median (p50) and the 10th percentile (p10) of the grader's score, over the graded answers.
-- Parameters: 1 window start (inclusive), 2 window end (exclusive), 3 the bucket, a unit date_trunc takes. UTC, as stored.
SELECT g.bucket, q.key, NULL::float8 AS n, g.d, q.value
FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, m."createdAt") AS bucket,
         count(*)::float8 AS d,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.grounded::float8) AS p50,
         percentile_cont(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.grounded::float8) AS p10
  FROM "Message" m
  WHERE m.role = 'ASSISTANT'
    AND m.grounded IS NOT NULL
    AND m."createdAt" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp
    AND m."createdAt" < $__timeTo()::timestamp
  GROUP BY 1
) g
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('p10'::text, g.p10), ('p50'::text, g.p50)) AS q(key, value)
ORDER BY 1, 2
) s
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: cost per active account
panels.description: cost per active account: the model spend recorded in the bucket, in USD, over the accounts with at least one message in it. The spend is every BudgetLedger row, whatever its kind; an account is a reader.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.bucket AS "time", s.value AS "cost per active account"
FROM (
-- cost per active account: the model spend recorded in the bucket, in USD, over the accounts with at least one message in it.
-- The spend is every BudgetLedger row, whatever its kind; an account is a reader.
-- Parameters: 1 window start (inclusive), 2 window end (exclusive), 3 the bucket, a unit date_trunc takes. UTC, as stored.
WITH spend AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, b."createdAt") AS bucket, sum(b."costUsd")::float8 AS usd
  FROM "BudgetLedger" b
  WHERE b."createdAt" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp
    AND b."createdAt" < $__timeTo()::timestamp
  GROUP BY 1
), active AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, m."createdAt") AS bucket, count(DISTINCT m."userId")::float8 AS accounts
  FROM "Message" m
  WHERE m."createdAt" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp
    AND m."createdAt" < $__timeTo()::timestamp
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(s.bucket, a.bucket) AS bucket,
       ''::text AS key,
       COALESCE(s.usd, 0) AS n,
       COALESCE(a.accounts, 0) AS d,
       COALESCE(s.usd, 0) / NULLIF(a.accounts, 0) AS value
FROM spend s
FULL JOIN active a ON a.bucket = s.bucket
ORDER BY 1
) s
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: cache read share
panels.description: cache read share: tokens read from the prompt cache over all prompt tokens, on the frontier alias's answered calls. The prompt is what was sent: the uncached input, the cache reads and the cache writes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.bucket AS "time", s.value AS "cache read share"
FROM (
-- cache read share: tokens read from the prompt cache over all prompt tokens, on the frontier alias's answered calls.
-- The prompt is what was sent: the uncached input, the cache reads and the cache writes.
-- Parameters: 1 window start (inclusive), 2 window end (exclusive), 3 the bucket, a unit date_trunc takes. UTC, as stored.
SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, b."createdAt") AS bucket,
       ''::text AS key,
       sum(b."cacheReadTokens")::float8 AS n,
       sum(b."inputTokens" + b."cacheReadTokens" + b."cacheWriteTokens")::float8 AS d,
       sum(b."cacheReadTokens")::float8 / NULLIF(sum(b."inputTokens" + b."cacheReadTokens" + b."cacheWriteTokens"), 0)::float8 AS value
FROM "BudgetLedger" b
WHERE b.alias = 'hb-frontier'
  AND b.outcome = 'ok'
  AND b."createdAt" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp
  AND b."createdAt" < $__timeTo()::timestamp
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
) s
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: edition mismatch share
panels.description: edition mismatch share: of the answers that cite the book, the share whose reader's language is not the cited edition's, one line per reader's language. While the Portuguese editions are pending, a Portuguese answer cites the English edition, and this is the measure of that gap. An answer that cites nothing has no edition to differ from and is outside the share.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.bucket AS "time", s.key AS metric, s.value
FROM (
-- edition mismatch share: of the answers that cite the book, the share whose reader's language is not the cited
-- edition's, one line per reader's language. While the Portuguese editions are pending, a Portuguese answer cites the
-- English edition, and this is the measure of that gap. An answer that cites nothing has no edition to differ from
-- and is outside the share.
-- Parameters: 1 window start (inclusive), 2 window end (exclusive), 3 the bucket, a unit date_trunc takes. UTC, as stored.
SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, m."createdAt") AS bucket,
       c.locale AS key,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(m."citesEdition") <> c.locale)::float8 AS n,
       count(*)::float8 AS d,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(m."citesEdition") <> c.locale)::float8 / count(*)::float8 AS value
FROM "Message" m
JOIN "Conversation" c ON c.id = m."conversationId"
WHERE m.role = 'ASSISTANT'
  AND m."refusalCause" IS NULL
  AND m."modelId" IS NOT NULL
  AND m."citesEdition" IS NOT NULL
  AND m."createdAt" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp
  AND m."createdAt" < $__timeTo()::timestamp
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
) s
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: purge
panels.description: purge: conversations whose text the retention run cleared, by the instant of the run that cleared them. The count of messages a run nulled is in the run's own job line, not in a row.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.bucket AS "time", s.value AS "purge"
FROM (
-- purge: conversations whose text the retention run cleared, by the instant of the run that cleared them.
-- The count of messages a run nulled is in the run's own job line, not in a row.
-- Parameters: 1 window start (inclusive), 2 window end (exclusive), 3 the bucket, a unit date_trunc takes. UTC, as stored.
SELECT date_trunc('day'::text, c."textPurgedAt") AS bucket,
       ''::text AS key,
       count(*)::float8 AS n,
       NULL::float8 AS d,
       count(*)::float8 AS value
FROM "Conversation" c
WHERE c."textPurgedAt" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp
  AND c."textPurgedAt" < $__timeTo()::timestamp
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
) s
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: purge · the job's own lines
panels.description: Each run of the retention job writes one line with what it cleared: messages, citations, mode results, conversations, abandoned turns closed. The series above counts conversations from the rows; the count of messages a run nulled exists only here.
